module.name: questionnaire
module.title: Questionnaire
module.description: Native fields and a server-owned step. Each step posts its answer and the server decides what comes next, so a reload resumes rather than restarts.

ui.name: question
ui.guidance: Radio and checkbox sets are a fieldset with a legend, because the question is the group's label: without it a screen reader reads the options with no idea what is being asked.

ui.name: questionnaire
ui.summary: Renders one step of a questionnaire.
ui.guidance: State lives on the server. A wizard that keeps answers in the browser loses them on reload, cannot be resumed on another device, and cannot be validated - so each step posts its answer and the server decides what comes next.

ui.name: wizard-actions
ui.guidance: The naming stays consistent across every step: the forward control is "Next" until the final step, where it is the submit verb. Changing the wording mid-flow makes the user re-read the button on every step to check what it now does.
